texts.zh:
[new_satrapy.GetName]已经归顺了大可汗！他们已成了[raider_khanate.GetName]的辖地，舰队也已解除了敌对状态。

虽然他们还没有正式加入[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]对于星辰大海的伟大征程，但已经承诺为大可汗的战争机器提供资源与人员！
texts.en:
The [new_satrapy.GetName] has submitted to the Great Khan! They have been made a Satrapy of the [raider_khanate.GetName], and their fleets are now standing down.

Although they have not officially joined the [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in their attempted conquest of the galaxy, they have pledged to contribute resources and military personnel to further bolster the Great Khan's war machine.
